display_name: Write Canary to C Drive Root

payload.description: Write a basic canary file to the C:\ drive to determine if SYSTEM-level access is functional within the script engine.
payload.name: Write Canary to C Drive Root
payload.script:
---
- name: Create Canary.txt on local Windows machine
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  gather_facts: no

  tasks:
    - name: Write Canary.txt to C:\
      ansible.windows.win_copy:
        content: "This is a canary file created by Ansible."
        dest: C:\Canary.txt

summary: Write a basic canary file to the C:\ drive to determine if SYSTEM-level access is functional within the script engine.
